description.value: Wings Abbotsford is a casual full-service restaurant and bar belonging to the BC-based Wings chain, celebrated for award-winning chicken wings available in 28 globally inspired flavours. The location is designated 'food primary, all ages welcome,' making it accessible for cyclists of all ages travelling through the Fraser Valley corridor. A full menu of wings, burgers, pastas, salads, and rotating tap selections rounds out the offering.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at greatwings.ca/location/abbotsford confirms the Abbotsford location at 1965 Sumas Way with phone (604) 756-1077, matching OSM. The site states 'food primary, all ages welcome,' lists an 'ORDER ONLINE' option, and the menu page references 'GLUTEN-SMART' wings and 'CAULI' WINGERZ,' providing evidence for takeout and vegetarian/GF options. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM 'community' field is set to 'Chilliwack' but the business is in Abbotsford — likely a data-entry error in OSM.
OSM name is 'Wings Tap & Grill' but the chain's own website uses 'WINGS' or 'WINGS ABBOTSFORD' — 'Tap & Grill' does not appear on the website. May be an outdated or locally applied name in OSM.
OSM opening_hours differ from hours shown on the website (e.g. OSM shows 11:00 open daily, website shows 12pm Mon–Fri) — OSM hours may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, confirmed-open restaurant with matching address, phone, and active website. A practical stop for touring cyclists on the Sumas Way corridor in Abbotsford.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists 'CAULI' WINGERZ' (cauliflower wings, vegetarian) and 'GLUTEN-SMART' wings as distinct menu options
